stops.text: Welcome! This is where the gravel road turns in and the driveway begins.
The house and main yard – the heart of the farm.
The back deck, looking out over the yard and garden.
The hill behind the house, with its sitting area and flower beds.
The greenhouse, shop and sheds on the north side of the yard.
The target range, just west of the yard.
Cougar Bridge – watch for the cougar on the roof.
The cabin, tucked into the trees at the end of Cabin Trail.
The southwest gate in the far corner of the quarter (government access).
The main culvert, where the creek passes under the trail by the pasture.
The lone tree, where the horses like to graze along the fence.
The pond in the north field.
The acreage entrance in the northeast corner – the end of the tour.
